create_scheduler: create a SelfForcingFlowMatchScheduler with configurable inference steps, shift, and sigma bounds
set_timesteps: set inference timesteps with configurable num_inference_steps and denoising_strength
run_step: run a single scheduling step given model output, timestep, and sample to compute prev_sample
add_noise_to_latents: add noise to clean latents at a given timestep using sigma interpolation
scale_model_input: scale model input sample returning the sample unchanged
